description: Every 15m collects per-run OODA 4/4, agentic 6/6, tempo :13, MoMA 5 tiers, graph G_workflow+G_history sizes, checkpoint health, verification scores, pacing filter stats. Writes JSONL to ultra/runs/metrics.jsonl and contacts_harness/.metrics.log and snapshots to observability/dashboard_metrics.json. Zero-deps node, no npm install. Even no-change logs mandatory 7-field timeline.
title: Observability tick — live health collector
